source.snippet: I'm using the Nextcloud Android app to automatically upload new photos and videos to my Nextcloud server. On my desktop, I'd like to have a GUI tool that downloads those files from Nextcloud's WebDAV server and deletes them afterwards - so that the files are not on the server anymore. Nextcloud desktop doesn't even support this workflow.

problem_statement: Self-hosted Nextcloud users need a simple GUI sync client that downloads files from WebDAV and deletes them from the server after transfer, enabling a 'offload-and-clear' workflow that the official Nextcloud desktop app does not support.
target_segment: Privacy-conscious home users and small teams self-hosting Nextcloud or other WebDAV servers on Linux desktops
notes: Niche but recurring ask in self-hosted communities. Official clients lack destructive-sync (delete-after-download) mode. Could be a small focused utility or plugin.
